non_identifiable_reason: The frozen historical v1 target did not preregister missing-aircraft and hostile/unlawful-action boundaries. Public evidence cannot resolve those semantics without retrospective target redefinition.

censoring_policy.walk_forward_rule: Exclude targets in a non-identifiable year and exclude any forecast interval whose open-after-cutoff through target-event interval intersects a non-identifiable year.

gate_effect: G1 research is closed as a structural limitation rather than an active evidence blocker. Downstream historical evaluation may accept G1 only with the censoring policy enforced; this does not open G2, G3 or G4.
prohibited_interpretations: MH370, MH17 or PS752 has been retrospectively included or excluded from frozen historical v1
prospective Target Taxonomy v2 resolves historical v1
CLOSED_WITH_LIMITATION is equivalent to strict 16/16 reconciliation
